summary: Sunlands Technology Group filed its annual report on Form 20-F for FY2025 with the SEC on April 24, 2026. The filing is a routine annual disclosure requirement under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, containing audited consolidated financial statements. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or management change is described. The press release simply announces the filing and provides access details. This is a standard periodic report with no transaction, strategic review, or corporate action that would classify it under any special-situations category. The registrant is the issuer filing its annual results.
